output.subject: Re: Monthly service charge - one time request
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for getting in touch, and for such a clear and courteous message.

We have received your request. You told us that a $12 monthly fee was charged after you let your balance drop, and you mentioned that this has never happened to you before. You asked whether that $12 fee could be reversed as a one-time request.

A specialist team is now reviewing your message, and they will respond to you within 10 business days.

We appreciate you explaining the circumstances so openly, and we understand that even a small, unexpected charge can be frustrating. If there is anything else you would like us to consider in the meantime, please reply to this email and we will pass it along with your request.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Decide whether to grant the requested one-time reversal of the $12 monthly fee; the draft makes no commitment either way.
Verify the customer's statement that this fee has not been charged before by checking their fee history.
Confirm the fee amount and the date it was charged match the customer's account.
Check the balance requirement and whether it applied to this account in the relevant month.
This is a simple courtesy request; consider whether the acknowledge-only reply is still needed or whether you can send a substantive answer directly.
